data.name: Task Bar Cube
data.detailed_description:
Task Bar Cube

Task Bar Cube is an idle RPG that runs on your desktop. Play the game in full screen or leave it open as a small window on your taskbar. Develop your characters and pets, collect gold and equipment, increase your power through idle upgrades, progress through the skill tree, and expand your limits in an RPG world with dozens of different progression systems.

Improve Your Equipment

Don't settle for the equipment you collect. Upgrade, transform, and strengthen your items using a variety of different systems.

  • Fusion: Combine unwanted items to create new items with randomized power.

  • Gem Socketing: Place gems into equipment sockets to gain additional stats and power.

  • Rarity Upgrade: Combine items of the same type to increase their rarity.

  • Tier Upgrade: Spend gold to upgrade your equipment and obtain stronger versions of your items.

  • Sale: Sell unwanted equipment to earn gold and make room in your inventory.

Expand Your Limits in the RPG World

Go beyond combat, discover different progression systems, and gather new resources to increase the power of your characters.

  • Hunting: Hunt for valuable resources and rare loot.

  • Farming: Grow crops, harvest them, and maintain a steady supply of resources.

  • Mining: Explore mines and collect valuable ores and raw materials.

  • Merchant: Trade your resources and equipment to make the most of what you collect.

  • Library: Gather knowledge and discover new opportunities for progression.

  • Animal Shelter: Collect, care for, and develop your pets.
